actions: User is authenticated via JWT token
User is added to online users map
All unread messages (up to 100) are automatically sent via 'newMessage' events

onDisconnect.description: Automatically triggered when connection is lost
actions: User is removed from online users map

curl.sendMessage: curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"recipientId": 2, "content": "Hello"}' http://localhost:3000/chat/messages
curl.markAsRead: curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"messageIds": [1,2,3]}' http://localhost:3000/chat/messages/read

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing JWT token

403.description: Forbidden - User doesn't have access to this resource

example.message: You do not have access to this chat session

bestPractices: Always save messages to database first before sending via WebSocket
Mark messages as delivered when received via 'newMessage' event
Mark messages as read when user opens/views the chat
Handle WebSocket disconnections gracefully with reconnection logic
Use the 'recipientOnline' field to show delivery status to users
Implement typing indicators for better UX
Load older messages via REST API (/chat/sessions/:id/messages) when user scrolls up
Use WebSocket for real-time messaging, REST API as fallback
Store JWT token securely (not in localStorage for production)
Implement exponential backoff for WebSocket reconnection attempts

read.description: Message opened and read by recipient
